scripts.build: npm run build -w @questrelay/shared && npm run build -w @questrelay/web && cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run build -w @questrelay/shared && npm run test -w @questrelay/shared && npm run test -w @questrelay/prototype && npm run test -w @questrelay/web && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: biome check . && cargo fmt --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.lint: biome lint . && cargo clippy --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
